info.title: IFPMIC AX Control API
info.description: Design contract. /api and /bridge are authenticated internal services. Accepted commands are durable, not completed operations. Read-only and control APIs never expose model credentials.

get.description: SSE id=event_id; data=Event JSON. Last-Event-ID resumes durable cursor. Expired cursor responds 410 and client reloads snapshot.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required for UserSession; ignored for scoped service bearer authentication.

put.description: Server validates owner, size and SHA256; incomplete object never becomes available.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required for UserSession; ignored for scoped service bearer authentication.

get.description: Authenticated bridge scope; long poll up to 25 seconds; same command may be redelivered until ACK.

BridgeCommand.description: Fields unrelated to the action are null. fetch_artifact and flash_profile require non-null artifact identifiers and SHA256; profile actions require profile version. The server and bridge both validate action-specific prerequisites.
